cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the WordPress Developer position at your company. With a strong foundation in web development and a passion for creating high-quality, user-friendly websites, I am confident that my skills and experience align well with your requirements.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have been responsible for building and maintaining client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme. I have developed custom page layouts, implemented content updates, and ensured that all sites are responsive and cross-browser compatible. My work involves close collaboration with designers and marketers to translate concepts into functional, visually appealing websites that meet client goals.

One of my key projects, mirook.com, showcases my ability to handle full-cycle WordPress development. I designed and built a multi-page site from scratch, integrating social media and implementing on-page SEO. I also implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema) and performed technical SEO/GEO audits, which significantly improved the site's visibility in both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This experience has given me a deep understanding of website optimization, security best practices, and SEO fundamentals.

I am proficient in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and PHP, and I am comfortable working with page builders like Elementor and WPBakery. I am also experienced in troubleshooting and resolving website issues promptly, ensuring seamless user experiences across devices.

I am a proactive problem-solver with excellent attention to detail and strong communication skills. I thrive in collaborative environments and am always eager to stay updated with the latest WordPress trends and best practices.

I am excited about the opportunity to bring my technical expertise and creative mindset to your team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your projects.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

- WordPress Development: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, custom theme/plugin development, responsive web design
- Web Technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, PHP, AngularJS

- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management
- Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)
